document: ET-8b VIII-c arm 1 — the lock. Every artefact of the seed-89 games and the three heads, by sha256 over the file. Fixed by Ri before the result was known (nirai 12980); the result cannot have shaped it.
claim_under_test: A frozen agent can use verified experience selected by another agent to exceed the plateau reached from its own experience.
where_the_bytes_are: the studio lane's results directory in the estate; not in this repository, and named here by basename and hash only

trees.note: two shas, not one: the tree was brought current between the collection and the scoring, so a single 'the run was at' line would be false

case_fold_collision.what: the B arm was named v_B and the base arm v_b; the collecting filesystem is case-insensitive, so the B arm's slice files resolved to the base arm's, every slice was skipped as already complete, and it reported the base arm's own green count without running an episode
case_fold_collision.tell: two arms printed COMPLETE in the same second; 300 episodes take about 12 s each
case_fold_collision.fix: c115312 — renamed to v_vb, and the collection script now refuses to start if any two arm names are equal under case folding

leakage_checks.why: the first attempt at this arm was withdrawn for contamination, so the repaired run's independence is measured rather than argued from the seeds being different

shared_programs.method: sha1 over each task's program text

shared_symptoms.reading: a symptom is the first thing the agent reads, so a head could in principle memorise symptom to region across disjoint programs. At most 5 of 300 tasks could transfer that way, against a gap of 13 points. The channel exists and is far too small to explain it.

heads_are_distinct.note: near-orthogonal weight vectors, distinct md5s and norms; no file mix-up of the kind the case-fold collision made

registered_before_collection.i: B solves a substantially different subset (>= 25% of its solved tasks unsolved by gen0's agent) -> the region is the policy's, not the task's
registered_before_collection.ii: the B-experience head beats g1-matched with the interval clearing the bar
registered_before_collection.iii: the union head beats both -> exchange compounds (NOT YET FITTED)
registered_before_collection.iv: B's subset overlaps gen0's (< 10% different) -> the region is the task's
registered_before_collection.x: reading (i) restated as B-only rate minus same-agent churn rate, paired bootstrap
registered_before_collection.xv_P1: NOT MEASURABLE at game time: the loop forces a hypothesis at decision 1 under every head, and the agent's free pick is identical across head arms, 300 of 300
registered_before_collection.xv_P1prime: the head's gain by decision. HOLDS in direction (+11.7 / +19.1 / +21.3 points over g1-matched at d1 / d2 / d3) and FAILS its 'small at d1' clause. The d1 comparison is the clean one -- identical states across arms -- and it is the smallest of the three.
registered_before_collection.xv_P2: HOLDS: of 170 B-only solves over three games, B named the true region at decision 1 on 105 (62%) and g1-matched on 6 (4%)
registered_before_collection.xv_P3: REFUTED, in the opposite direction: mean actions FALL under the B head (7.59 against a base of 8.21), because a correct first pick ends the episode sooner

readings.verdict_on_the_arm: vb minus g1m clears criterion (a) in 3 of 3 games and (b) in 2 of 3: game 2's lower bound is +1.0 against a 2.0-point bar. Reported as 2 of 3 rather than pooled until it passes.
readings.also_on_record: g1-matched fails criterion (a) against the base bracket in all three games, which reproduces the earlier plateau on a third task set: more of the same agent's experience does not clear the bar.

decision_1_pick_correct_pct.note: identical across the three games by construction: decision 1 runs at temperature 0 on an identical state, so a given head's first pick is deterministic
